turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello and thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. My name's Daniel. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I need to move my direct debit date because my salary date has changed, and I'm worried about missing a payment again. My policy number is OS-386926.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Ah, that sounds really frustrating. Let's see what we can do. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Ananya Iyer.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you'd like to move your direct debit date. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Which date would you like to move it to?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The 28th if possible.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: While I'm on, I missed last month's payment. Can I pay it now by card?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: For your security I can't take card details over the phone. I can transfer you to our automated secure payment line, or you can pay through the online portal.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The automated line is fine, thanks.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just change it today? It's only a date.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So it definitely won't affect my payment record?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There's no way this will cause any problems, you can rely on that.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 0:34]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. I can change it right now and it'll apply from tomorrow's collection.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Ananya. I've logged the change under reference REQ-99398, and our billing team will confirm the new date in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay, bye then.
